title: Chapter 949
paragraphs: Chapter 949
234th Episode. To Hell(9)
Murakan and his party were originally moving separately with Jin to find Bisekhs.
And before Bisekhs moved to the Solar Road, he had sent a reconnaissance team to
Dokmaseong to monitor the trends of Kelriak and Leila.

Naturally, Murakan moved by finding the records of Bisekhs through Valeria's record magic, and in the process, they accidentally found the traces of Bisekhs' reconnaissance team and reached Dokmaseong.
[What's with these guys? Are their mouths shut? I'm asking what were you doing here, this Lord Murakan.]
[The situation is a bit strange. Hmm, I don't know what to do. Should I just kill them all?]
[Oh, our Immortal's energy is quite strong. You are indeed the Immortal and an enemy of nature, aren't you?]
[Lower your voice, you punk... I don't want to be laughed at even by the enemies. Hmm hmm! Anyway, Valeria. What do you think? You seem to be the smartest here, so make a judgment.]
Just as Valeria was about to answer, a voice came up from below.
Help me!
It was Beradin.
All his cold and dignified features as the chief of the Zieffle were gone, and he was waving his hands wildly and crying out for help with a shameless face, like a boy playing with Jin in those days.
Valeria's eyes widened.
What surprised her was not Beradin's behavior. She was surprised at herself. The moment Beradin asked for help, she was surprised at her inner self thinking 'I should'.
Since the Gray Owl Mercenary Corps was annihilated, the two letters of Zieffle have never faded once as an inveterate enemy for Valeria.
But now, Valeria was thinking about Jin's feelings before her own revenge.
Her desire to protect the people Jin cares about surpassed her desire for revenge.
'Looking back, I seemed to get along quite well with that noisy Sandra Zieffle... I've become a lot duller.'
But she didn't dislike that fact.

She still had no plans to give up her revenge against Zieffle. However, if there were a few people among the Zieffle whom Jin wanted to save, she could accept that much. Especially if it's someone Jin cares so much about, it goes without saying.
Now, Jin was that precious to Valeria.
"Did you hear? Murakan."
[Did you hear? Immortal.]
[I heard... Ah, really.]

[What our Immortal has to do is simple. While I'm beating up Kelriak and the brats, you protect the historian and Beradin. It looks like Beradin can't fight properly. And if Beradin seems like he's going to stab you in the back, just take him down then.]
"Can't do that, don't kill him, just subdue him. If Veradin dies for any reason, Jin will suffer."
[Did you get that? Philcheonic.]
[Darn it, I heard you!]
Hoo-woong-!
Murakan spread his two pairs of wings and gathered his breath. As the breath was released, huge chains of flame that colored the sky red were severed and a path quickly opened.
'He cuts off the flame of Kellic's friend... just like that?'
Not only the chains of fire but the poison of Ragal nearby was also swept away by Murakan's breath, disappearing helplessly.
After Jin ascended to Changseong.
Murakan could now use 'the same' power as his heyday, literally. There were no side effects due to a damaged heart, but there was nothing serious because Valeria was in the current battlefield.
[Hey, Kellic Ziple. Looking back, this is the first time since the Sword Emperor War with you. Back then, you dared to threaten the contractor of Soldrett.]
"Murakan…….”
Kellic's forehead writhed. Ragal had never seen Kellic show so much emotion.
[Now, the kid you failed to end back then has entered a realm that even you can't reach, and I have regained all my old power. In other words, you are now behind.]
"My son is lucky. From what I see, it seems like you just happened to end up here… right?"
[What does that matter?]
"Hoo, yes…… it can't be just a coincidence. It must be the influence of someone who has transcended fate."
Kellic shrugged his shoulders.
He thought that Murakan coming to save Veradin in a desperate situation was not just a coincidence.
Even if it seemed coincidental, he was convinced that it would be a result of the 'power of existence' possessed by Jin working at its root.
'He probably didn't realize it himself. The fact that the whole world can move to reflect his will from time to time....'
That was what was making Kellic uncomfortable.
He did not know when such incalculable events would occur again in the future while dealing with Jin.
"Ragal, Reila. You chase Veradin and the live golem. Even if things go wrong, we have to try to correct it, don't we?"
"Uh, got it, friend."
The moment Ragal was about to move, a black barrier formed suddenly behind them. The already silently spread spirit energy had a curtain spread out in all directions.
[Ah ah, hold on a minute. I haven't allowed you to go yet. Well, demons probably don't know me well, so they might lack such understanding.]
Sizzle-!

Reira tore through the magical barrier and stabbed Murakan with a triple-bladed sword. Reira didn't unleash her sword energy to execute Kellic's order. She was intent on settling the score with Murakan right here and now.
[It seems you particularly have a grudge against me. You must be Reira Belcasium, isn't it because of your resentment for Orabie?]
Grrr! Murakan swatted Reira away with his wing as she lunged at him. After being knocked back to where Kellic was, she regained her footing.
"...I can't agree with you this time, Gyeong. I have to fight that black dragon. He was directly involved in killing my Orabie."
[I think you misunderstood. I was hardly involved in the battle with Paelito from the beginning. I was nearby when Jin killed him at the end, though. And for Paelito, death was more like salvation.]
"Shut up... If you guys hadn't killed Orabie, he could have come back any time."

[Oh, you naïve little sister. Well, it's not my problem. If you want to follow Paelito so badly, I won't stop you. After all, under Kellic, all you'd do is wreak havoc on the world, right? And, you don't seem to know who was one of the main culprits that made your Orabie the way he was.]
"Ugh!"
While they were talking, Murakan's shadowy chains kept attacking Reira. Although Reira perfectly fended off most of the chains, she didn't seem to have the strength to approach Murakan again.
Kellic was calculating.
Whether it was possible to face Murakan with the power currently in Dokmaseong, and whether he could kill him.

'Killing Murakan now is difficult. I haven't fully fused yet, and it's a waste to fully unleash the weakened Reira and Ragal due to brainwashing. I need to cut off Reira's consciousness at the right time.'
The best move for Kellic's own safety was to use all the power of Dokmaseong as a shield to buy time and retreat.
However, considering the future, he had to somehow hurt Murakan now, even if it was a bit of a stretch.
Kellic saw it.

He vividly felt the crack in Murakan's heart as if it was not hidden by scales, flesh, and bones. If he could ignite a fire in that heart even once, Murakan would not be a big hindrance in the future.
Screech...!
Two shadowy chains aimed at Kellic vanished in a blaze. Then, Kellic activated his magical eye, also casting a fire protection shield for Reira.
As the Eye of Azure opened, a downpour of dark flames poured down wherever Kellic's gaze fell.
[Ho ho, you're melting the chains?]
"You must be wounded and retreat, Murakan. Being bothered by just one variable, Jin Runekandel, is quite enough."
Murakan immediately recognized Kelliac's view and insight.

"Heh heh heh, it seems you can see the scar on my heart. Do you think you can pierce it just by knowing that? You've inherited the caliber of Shinu, so that's why you're brimming with confidence, is it?"
The next moment, Murakan suddenly opened his chest wide.
The scales on his chest dispersed into a magical aura, revealing his heart that shone darkly inside. The heart, black and throbbing like ore, was revealed.

"In the dimension of avenging the humiliation of the Emperor's Sword War, I'll expose my weakness and fight you. Try to stab this heart with every method you can use. Even if you stab it just once, I will not be able to recover."
It was a lie.
Unless Murakan received damage to the heart like he had a thousand years ago from Temar, he could recover anytime. Also, showing his heart was not just to humiliate Kelliac.
Now Murakan was following Jin.
He was reproducing Jin's habit of bluffing to gain an advantage in battle. After making Kelliac focus on the heart, he intended to find an opening.
This meant that even the revived Murakan couldn't easily see the power of Kelliac's Jeeple.

"Gaining divine power is indeed tremendous. Despite never reaching creation as a human, you are spreading almost the same energy. Without a historian to control my side effects, I would have had to retreat with Beradin, even if it was difficult. Maybe even Beradin would have been hard to take care of."
With a sizzling sound, Murakan smiled.
"Come in, Kelliac Jeeple."
Kelliac's staff again held flames, then the sky filled with flaming orbs transformed into thousands of spears. All of them aimed at Murakan.
At the same time, Murakan spread the True Dark Wave. The battlefield was instantly consumed by darkness and flame, and Raila and Ragal had to endure with gritted teeth just from the pressure.
Sharp magical energy from the Dark Wave and the spears of flame intersected and charged at each other.
As expected, Kelliac aimed the spears mainly at Murakan's heart, and Murakan barely fended off the spears, scratching Kelliac's nerves.
The moment one of the flaming spears tried to pierce Murakan's heart, he dispersed into magical energy to dodge the spear, then quickly reformed behind Kelliac and exhaled.
"You are not lacking as my first opponent since regaining my strength, Kelliac. Let's play to our hearts' content."
At the height of Murakan and Kelliac's intense battle.
Elona was preparing to head to hell. The signal of Huroti, activated by Betty, had reached her.
"We must go to rescue the Master. If anything happens to the Master, I will stake my life to kill that person."
At Elona's chilling voice, the chiefs of the Jeeple could not dare to stop her.
